barResizeInstructions: Please measure with a ruler placed on the screen the length of the blue line displayed below
noRuler: Click the button below if you do not have a ruler at hand and would prefer to perform the screen calibration using a credit or identity card.
calibration: Click and drag the lower right corner of the box until the box is the same size as a credit card held up to the screen.
instructionExample: Here is an example of the task. You're asked to indicate if you see a face in the image or not. Press {{nofacekey}} to indicate no face or {{facekey}} to indicate face.
instructionTexts:
Step 1:
A white cross is displayed in the middle of the screen.
Look at it and keep focus.

Step 2:
Shortly afterwards, an image will be displayed. You will be asked to indicate if you can see a face in the image or not.

Step 3:
While the image is being displayed, press the {{nofacekey}} to indicate that no face is present in the image,
or press the {{facekey}} to indicate that a face is present.
These three steps will be repeated several times throughout the experiment.
REMINDER press the {{nofacekey}} key to indicate that no face is present in the image, or press the {{facekey}} key to indicate that a face is present.
instructionScreenExample: Did you see a face in the image
